en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1584 - Ma'ruf ibn Kharrabudh reports from Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, has paired Zakat with prayer, as He said:
(Surah Al Baqarah 2:43). Therefore, whoever establishes prayer but does not give Zakat, it is as though he has not established prayer."
